warnings: All three previously identified blocking issues are resolved.
The LOSO split is implemented as a single fixed held-out subject rather than a complete LOSO evaluation across all subjects, but this is not a train/test leakage issue.
The implementation assumes three-dimensional embedding tensors for contrastive_loss() because it pools along dimension 2; this assumption is not validated beyond checking shape equality.
The temporal mean pooling strategy changes the learning objective by discarding temporal information before contrastive matching. This is an architectural choice rather than a correctness issue.
summary: The previous blocking issues have been fully resolved. The subject-level train/test leakage has been eliminated, the runtime error caused by mean(dim=1) has been removed, and the loss is now a valid symmetric InfoNCE-style objective. No new blocking logic errors, runtime bugs, research methodology violations, or train/test leakage issues were introduced. The remaining observations are non-blocking design considerations. The change is safe to accept.
